title: C4OS Grill Question 010 - Unassigned Chat Scope

questions.label: Where should unassigned chats live?
questions.help: Recommended: user-global shell chat history. This matches the plugin-free app shell and keeps no-project chats available regardless of workspace file.

questions.label: What should the unassigned chat area be called in the UI?
questions.help: Recommended: Chats. It is short, neutral, and avoids implying project/workspace ownership.

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether unassigned chats can use runtime tools, attach files, or later be moved into a project.
